name: rock_v1
doc: A rock (design/systems.md, Rocks): the game asks for a material, a size, moss, and a season; the body makes the rock and the pieces its material breaks into, and the animator throws the pieces when the game breaks it.

params.name: material
params.doc: A material: one entry from config/rock_v1_materials/.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Which of the distinct rocks per material and size (the runtime caps how many by quality).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: break_time
params.doc: Seconds since the rock broke; negative while it is whole. The game starts it (foundry_rock_v1_start_break).

params.name: break_heading
params.doc: Where the blow sends the pieces, from +Z toward +X.
